US chemical company Chemours to pay $450 million over 'forever chemicals'

The US government has reached a settlement with chemical company Chemours over illegal discharges of PFAS, also known as 'forever chemicals'. The agreement requires Chemours to pay $450 million to resolve enforcement claims. This marks the first time the federal government has settled such claims with a major manufacturer of these synthetic compounds.
